presentationProfile.title: Factorial
presentationProfile.description: Factorial brings HR, payroll, time tracking, talent, and finance processes into one platform.

applyApplication.description: Submit an application for a position through Factorial ATS.

clockIn.description: Record the start of a shift for an employee. The shift stays open until clocked out.

clockOut.description: Complete an open shift by recording its clock-out time. The shift must have been started with the clock-in endpoint.

createAccount.description: Create a finance account in Factorial.

createApplication.description: Create an ATS application for a candidate and job posting.

createEmployee.description: Create an employee record with the supplied name, email, and hire date.

createJobPosting.description: Create a job posting in Factorial ATS.

createLeave.description: Create a leave request with an employee ID, date range, and leave type.

createShift.description: Create a shift using an employee ID and start and end times.

createWebhookSubscription.description: Create a webhook subscription with a destination URL and selected events.

deleteEmployee.description: Delete the employee record identified by its ID.

duplicateJobPosting.description: Create a copy of an existing job posting.

getEmployee.description: Retrieve the employee record identified by its ID.

listApplications.description: List job applications with their candidate and job-posting details.

listCandidates.description: List candidate records available to your account. Visibility depends on API credential permissions and hiring-manager access.

listCredentials.description: List API credentials available to the authenticated account.

listEmployees.description: List employee records visible to the authenticated user. Returned details depend on permissions assigned to the API user.

listJobPostings.description: List job postings in Factorial ATS.

listLeaves.description: Retrieve employee leave requests from Factorial.

listShifts.description: List employee shift records in Factorial.

listWebhookSubscriptions.description: List webhook subscriptions configured for the Factorial account.

updateEmployee.description: Update an employee record by ID using the supplied employee details.
